process: Separately reviewed seed/identity preparation after isolation; no real login or session in this phase
gate_control: All membership/age controls below must pass the SAME live owner/test gate and AAL2/session checks in rehearsal, isolating age and entitlement denial. Gate allowlisting needs its separate identity approval.
entitlement_schema: Preserve allowed values. Add nullable starts_at/expires_at/revoked_at; update invoker vq_fixture.allowed to enforce those fields while retaining own-row RLS and original grants.
required_paths: direct base table SELECT under actual staged RLS
expired/revoked session with otherwise active member denied
evidence_requirement: Record every identity/path as PASS/FAIL/UNRUN. No empty fixture or helper-only pass establishes all original contracts. Current disposable helper test covers protected table/view/RPC shapes; full prepared-schema and hosted tests remain later work.
preservation: Existing fixture IDs, rows, original allowed values and age states stay unchanged; new identities use new UUIDs allocated only by the reviewed identity process. No credentials, production users, real MFA material, email or SMS delivery copied or enabled.
preservation_digest: Verify preexisting rows by ordered ROW(user_id,allowed)::text digest after adding NULL temporal columns. Whole-row hashes change solely from added columns; record that planned schema change and establish a new approved baseline.
